title: chlorophora tinctoria subsp. mora
intro: Chlorophora tinctoria subsp. mora, commonly known as Catechu or Black catechu, is a plant species that belongs to the family Celastraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, fever, and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Catechu include its ability to act as an antiseptic, astringent, and antipyretic, making it effective in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include catechin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
